## About this keyboard

The Atlas Pro is a 65% gasket-mount board aimed squarely at people who want enthusiast sound without a four-week group buy. It ships with factory-lubed linear switches, a polycarbonate plate and a two-layer foam sandwich that keeps the case quiet without going mushy.

Connectivity is tri-mode: wired USB-C, 2.4 GHz dongle, and Bluetooth 5.1 with three device slots. The 4,000 mAh battery is rated for about 240 hours of wireless use with backlighting off.
